name: Sharetronic Data Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sharetronic Data Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, and provision of advanced hardware and software solutions in China and internationally. The company offers AIoT smart hardware, data storage terminals, edge computing devices, and intelligent control terminals; computing support for cloud video, cloud gaming, and large model training/inference; and Fcloud AI Training/Inference Platform. It also provides cloud services; and manufactures intelligent storage devices.
